name: Rojo Studio
description: Rojo for Roblox in Orca: install Rojo, start and stop rojo serve with live logs and a connected-Studio indicator, build .rbxl/.rbxm files, generate sourcemaps for luau-lsp, create projects and see the instance tree your project file maps. Unofficial; not affiliated with Rojo or Roblox.

commands.title: Rojo: Show or hide the panel (right sidebar)
Rojo: Start or stop the server for this workspace
Rojo: Stop all servers and watchers

statusBarItems.tooltip: Rojo Studio: show or hide the panel

settings.title: Default server address
settings.description: Where new servers listen. "This computer only" binds 127.0.0.1. "All network interfaces" binds 0.0.0.0, so Roblox Studio in a virtual machine or on another computer can connect; anyone on your network can then read your project.

settings.title: Default port
settings.description: Used when the project file has no servePort. Rojo's own default is 34872.

settings.title: Run Rojo in
settings.description: Automatic runs Rojo as a background process for workspaces on this computer and in an Orca terminal for remote (SSH) workspaces, using the rojo on that host.

settings.title: Path to rojo
settings.description: Leave empty to pick Rojo automatically (a tool-manager pin in the project, then PATH, then a version this plugin installed). Otherwise the absolute path of a rojo executable.

settings.title: Watch sourcemap.json while serving
settings.description: Also runs rojo sourcemap --watch when a server starts, for luau-lsp.

settings.title: Notify when a server or watcher fails
Check GitHub for new Rojo releases
settings.description: At most once an hour, from api.github.com. Nothing about you is sent.
